items.title: Coinbase makes a bigger push into crypto derivatives
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Coinbase's (COIN) latest offering, Deribit options and perpetuals, to its institutional customers. 

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Hackers beware: Coinbase says 99% of customer crypto is kept offline
items.summary: The exchange says the record Binance hack left its systems and customer funds untouched.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks crash in steepest selloff since Liberation Day
items.summary: The post-election rally lasted one day before markets turned sharply lower.

items.title: Coinbase Sinks 9% as Bitcoin Falls Below $76,000
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoinbase shares fell 9% today as Bitcoin dropped below $76,000 in a broad market sell-off. Coinbase fell almost three times as far as the S&P 500 because its fees and earnings move with Bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin Slides 5% as Tech Rout Deepens
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest level since September Thursday as the tech sell-off intensifies.

items.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $76K, Wiping Out Over $1B Crypto Bets: MSTR, BMNR, CRCL, COIN Stocks Tumble Double Digits
items.summary: Ethereum, Solana, Ripple’s XRP, and Dogecoin saw a steeper drop than Bitcoin in the last 24 hours amid the crypto sell-off.

items.title: Does the CLARITY Act Die on January 3? What That Means for XRP
items.summary: A midterm shift in Congress and two high-profile House losses have left crypto's biggest bill on a ticking clock. One lawyer says the calendar could decide XRP's regulatory future before the new year arrives.

items.title: Bitcoin tumbles below $76,000 as post-election stock rally fades
items.summary: Bitcoin tumbled below $77,000 on Thursday as investors moved out of riskier assets amid a broad sell-off in stocks.
